name: 日乃屋 本店
address_ja: 〒113-0034 東京都文京区湯島2-2-1 東邦深澤ビル 1F
cuisine: The Yushima original of 日乃屋カレー, the chain that grew from this 19-seat room to about a hundred shops and on to California and Taiwan. The house roux is sold on a single line — 「始まり甘く、後より辛い、余韻残りしカレールウ」, sweet at the first mouthful, hot afterwards, and lingering — and the honten also keeps the chūka-soba and tsukemen the chain shops dropped. Sub-¥1,000.
neighborhood: Yushima 2-chōme, Bunkyō-ku — 405 m and about 6 minutes from JR Ochanomizu's Hijiribashi exit: north past the Yushima Seidō crossing, over the Shimizuzaka-shita junction and left. About 10 minutes west along Kuramaebashi-dōri from Suehirochō (Tokyo Metro Ginza line).
gf_detail: No, and this one is not close. The company's whole proposition is 「日本のカレー、昔からある皆が食べ慣れた、あの懐かしくも深みのあるカレー」 — Japanese-style curry, which is by definition a roux thickened with wheat flour, and the shop describes the roux as made by its own in-house method with no substitution claimed. The honten additionally boils wheat chūka-soba and tsukemen noodles in the same small kitchen (Tabelog files it as カレー、ラーメン、つけ麺), and the signature item is a breadcrumbed katsu — the 名物カツカレー, now also sold as a 三元豚・プレミアムカツカレー. No allergen information is published on hinoya.jp and no gluten-free item exists at any branch.
vegan_detail: Correcting the light record, which carried vegan_status 'options': nothing supports that. The company describes buying meat from the west of Japan, branded eggs, and vegetables chosen nationally, and the standard bowls are katsu, pork and beef; the honten also runs a chūka-soba stock. A newer 印度式カレー roux is advertised as 「スパイスとベジタブルが効きまくり」, but that is a description of flavour, not a vegan claim, and the site says explicitly that whether a branch carries it varies. No vegan or vegetarian item is listed anywhere on the official site, and Japanese curry roux routinely contains animal extract and honey.

roles: 代表者 (representative director, 有限会社ノアランド / Noahland Ltd.)
chef_bio.origin: Yushima 2-chōme, Bunkyō-ku — the company's registered head office is this building, 東京都文京区湯島2-2-1 東邦深澤ビル1階
chef_bio.background: 有限会社ノアランド was founded in August 2004 and the Yushima honten is both the first 日乃屋カレー and, to this day, the company's registered address — the head office is the shop. The house line, printed at the top of the company's own page, is 「始まり甘く、後より辛い、余韻残りしカレールウ」: sweet at the start, hot afterwards, with an aftertaste that stays. The company is explicit that it is not chasing modern curry styles — 「昨今ありとあらゆるスタイルのカレーが世に出回っていますが、日乃屋は一貫して日本のカレー、昔からある皆が食べ慣れた、あの懐かしくも深みのあるカレーを日々追求しております」 — and that the goal is not 'sweet!' or 'hot!' but 「美味かった。また来るよ！」. It is equally blunt about buying: meat from western Japan, branded eggs, vegetables chosen nationally by season, and a spice blend so complicated that 「作っている本人が間違えてしまうくらいの種類の調合」; wholesalers, it says, complain about how hard the company is on sourcing and on price. The chain went from this room to 97 shops by January 2023 and has since added dozens more, including San Francisco, San Jose and Berkeley in California, Qingdao, and Kaohsiung. Its retort-pouch curry range won a Gold Award at OMOTENASHI Selection 2025. The honten is 19 seats — 11 at the counter, 8 at tables — cash only, all non-smoking, no reservations, with takeaway; it is the branch that still serves chūka-soba and tsukemen alongside the curry, which the company site treats as part of the same craft: 「中華そばのスープ。カレーのルウも日乃屋ならではの手法が用いられております」.
chef_bio.philosophy: 始まり甘く、後より辛い、余韻残りしカレールウ — and beyond the taste, getting the customer to 「美味かった。また来るよ！」 rather than merely to a reaction.
chef_bio.specialty: 名物カツカレー — the katsu curry the chain is known for, now also in a 三元豚・プレミアムカツカレー version; the newer 印度式カレー roux at selected branches; and, at the honten specifically, 中華そば and つけ麺.

anecdotes.text: The head office of a hundred-shop chain is still the counter it started at: the company's 会社概要 gives its 所在地 as 〒113-0034 東京都文京区湯島2-2-1 東邦深澤ビル1階 — the honten's address.
On sourcing, the company quotes its own suppliers against itself: 「日乃屋さんは仕入れうるさいからね（値段交渉も）…」と問屋さんから泣かれることもあります.
The chain's retort-pouch curry took a Gold Award at OMOTENASHI Selection 2025, and the pouches are sold over the counter as souvenirs at a growing number of branches.

The official site hinoya.jp confirms the brand line 「始まり甘く、後より辛い、余韻残りしカレールウ」, the deliberate commitment to old-fashioned Japanese curry, the sourcing policy, the 名物カツカレー and its 三元豚 premium version, the newer 印度式カレー roux (availability varies by branch), and the OMOTENASHI Selection 2025 Gold Award; its 会社概要 page gives 有限会社ノアランド, representative 日浦大, establishment August 2004, capital ¥3m, 97 shops as of January 2023, and a head-office address identical to the honten, together with a dated shop-opening log running from 2012 to 2025 and including San Francisco (2021), Berkeley (2024), Qingdao (2024), San Jose (2025) and Kaohsiung (2025).

gf_cross_contamination.text: A 19-seat kitchen that fries breadcrumbed katsu and boils wheat chūka-soba and tsukemen noodles alongside the curry. No allergen information is published and no wheat-free item exists.
The product itself is Japanese-style curry roux — the company's stated commitment is to 「日本のカレー」, which is flour-thickened by definition.

vegan_cross_contact.text: The company describes sourcing meat from western Japan and branded eggs as base ingredients, and the honten additionally makes a chūka-soba stock; the signature dish is a pork katsu.

cultural_comfort.level: Very easy — but cash, and a walk
cultural_comfort.note: Six minutes north of JR Ochanomizu's Hijiribashi exit, past Yushima Seidō — a pleasant walk but further than the 御茶ノ水駅周辺 label suggests, and in Bunkyō-ku rather than Chiyoda. Nineteen seats, no reservations, takeaway available, and cash only: no cards, no electronic money, no QR payment. Closed Sundays and public holidays, with occasional unscheduled closures (不定休有), a 15:00 finish on Saturdays and a 15:00–17:00 break on Mondays; last orders are half an hour before closing. There is an English section on the brand site (HINOYA CURRY (ENGLISH)) even though the honten itself does not advertise an English menu, and curry ordering is simple enough that language is rarely the obstacle. If you want the chain's newer 印度式カレー roux, ring first — the company says availability varies by branch. Retort-pouch curry is sold over the counter and makes a genuinely good souvenir.

enrich_note: Confirmed. A nationwide Tabelog keyword search for 日乃屋 (HTTP 200, 165件) returns 日乃屋 本店 as its first hit, 13129028, at 東京都文京区湯島2-2-1 東邦深澤ビル1F — 405 m from JR Ochanomizu, matching the light record's 御茶ノ水駅周辺 — with the genre カレー、ラーメン、つけ麺 against the sweep's 「カレー・定食」. The identification is nailed down independently by the company register on hinoya.jp/company, which gives 有限会社ノアランド's 所在地 as the same building and floor; every other 日乃屋 on Tabelog is a branded 日乃屋カレー branch elsewhere. Coordinates updated to Tabelog's (35.703214, 139.765706), about 440 m north of the sweep's approximate pin, and the postcode 〒113-0034 is taken from the company's own registration rather than inferred. One correction carried into the record: the light record had vegan_status 'options', which nothing on the official site supports — it has been changed to 'no', with the reasoning set out in vegan_detail so a reviewer can see what was and was not found.
